integrity: All exact calculations are self-contained in RESULT.md and independently reconstructed by the included symbolic verifier. The paper/model is credited to its original authors; only the specific stability and local pitchfork deductions are assessed here.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local to an admissible two-community parameter choice and to negative original opinions away from switching surfaces.
No global attraction, no global bifurcation diagram, and no classification of unequal equilibria far from the symmetric endemic state.
The claim is supported by analytic proof and exact symbolic checks, but independent external scientific validation has not been performed.
title: An opinion-connectivity threshold and subcritical symmetry breaking in a two-community higher-order SIS model
